However, the evidence is limited to the direct indication chain and does not provide direct evidence of a therapeutic or pharmacological relationship between Amphotericin B and Erythrasma. The strength of the evidence is moderate, as it relies on indirect pathways and does not include direct clinical or pharmacological data.
